Summary

Image fusion is a fundamental task in medical image analysis and computer-assisted intervention.

arxiv-2106-04572.title: Extent of frustration in the classical Kitaev- Γ \Gamma model via bond anisotropy
arxiv-2106-04572.creator: Ahmed Rayyan 1 , Qiang Luo 1 , Hae-Young Kee 1,2
arxiv-2106-04572.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ahmed Rayyan 1 , Qiang Luo 1 , Hae-Young Kee 1,2. In the pseudospin- 1 2 \frac{1}{2} honeycomb Mott insulators with strong spin-orbit coupling, there are two types of bond-dependent exchange interactions, named Kitaev ( K K ) and Γ \Gamma , leading to strong frustration. While the ground state of the Kitaev model is a quantum spin liquid with fractionalized excitations, the ground state of the Γ \Gamma model remains controversial.

arxiv-2109-00166.title: A Fokker-Planck feedback control framework for optimal personalized therapies in colon cancer-induced angiogenesis
arxiv-2109-00166.creator: Souvik Roy, Zui Pan, Suvra Pal
arxiv-2109-00166.description: Abstract In this paper, a new framework for obtaining personalized optimal treatment strategies in colon cancer-induced angiogenesis is presented. The dynamics of colon cancer is given by a Itó stochastic process, which helps in modeling the randomness present in the system.

arxiv-2301-09556.title: A noisy-input generalised additive model for relative sea-level change along the Atlantic coast of North America
arxiv-2301-09556.creator: Maeve Upton, Andrew Parnell, Andrew Kemp, Erica Ashe, Gerard McCarthy, Niamh Cahill
arxiv-2301-09556.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Maeve Upton, Andrew Parnell, Andrew Kemp, Erica Ashe, Gerard McCarthy, Niamh Cahill. We propose a Bayesian, noisy-input, spatial-temporal generalised additive model to examine regional relative sea-level (RSL) changes over time. The model provides probabilistic estimates of component drivers of regional RSL change via the combination of a univariate spline capturing a common regional signal over time, random slopes and intercepts capturing site-specific (local), long-term linear trends and a spatial-temporal spline capturing residual, non-linear, local variations.

arxiv-2310-15793.title: Improving generalization in large language models by learning prefix subspaces
arxiv-2310-15793.creator: Louis Falissard, Vincent Guigue, Laure Soulier(1) Sorbonne Université, CNRS, ISIR, 75005 Paris, France(2) Bibliothèque nationale de France, 75013 Paris, France(3) AgroParisTech, UMR MIA-PS, 91120 Palaiseau, France louis.falissard@gmail.com, vincent.guigue@isir.upmc.fr, laure.soulier@isir.upmc.fr
arxiv-2310-15793.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Louis Falissard, Vincent Guigue, Laure Soulier(1) Sorbonne Université, CNRS, ISIR, 75005 Paris, France(2) Bibliothèque nationale de France, 75013 Paris, France(3) AgroParisTech, UMR MIA-PS, 91120 Palaiseau, France louis.falissard@gmail.com, vincent.guigue@isir.upmc.fr, laure.soulier@isir.upmc.fr. This article focuses on large language models (LLMs) fine-tuning in the scarce data regime (also known as the "few-shot" learning setting). We propose a method to increase the generalization capabilities of LLMs based on neural network subspaces.

arxiv-2402-00700.title: In-Bed Pose Estimation: A Review
arxiv-2402-00700.creator: Ziya Ata Yazıcı, Sara Colantonio, Hazım Kemal Ekenel
arxiv-2402-00700.description: Abstract Human pose estimation, the process of identifying joint positions in a person’s body from images or videos, represents a widely utilized technology across diverse fields, including healthcare. One such healthcare application involves in-bed pose estimation, where the body pose of an individual lying under a blanket is analyzed.

arxiv-2402-08906.title: Decay-protected superconducting qubit with fast control enabled by integrated on-chip filters
arxiv-2402-08906.creator: Aashish Sah, Suman Kundu, Heikki Suominen, Qiming Chen, Mikko Möttönen
arxiv-2402-08906.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Aashish Sah, Suman Kundu, Heikki Suominen, Qiming Chen, Mikko Möttönen. Achieving fast gates and long coherence times for superconducting qubits presents challenges, typically requiring either a stronger coupling of the drive line or an excessively strong microwave signal to the qubit. To address this, we introduce on-chip filters of the qubit drive exhibiting a stopband at the qubit frequency, thus enabling long coherence times and strong coupling at the subharmonic frequency, facilitating fast single-qubit gates, and reduced thermal load.

arxiv-2505-09561.title: Learning Long-Context Diffusion Policies via Past-Token Prediction
arxiv-2505-09561.creator: Marcel Torne, Andy Tang, Yuejiang Liu, Chelsea Finn
arxiv-2505-09561.description: Abstract Reasoning over long sequences of observations and actions is essential for many robotic tasks. Yet, learning effective long-context policies from demonstrations remains challenging. As context length increases, training becomes increasingly expensive due to rising memory demands, and policy performance often degrades as a result of spurious correlations.

pmc-12558463.title: Intersecting challenges and ways forward: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on an urban First Nations community in Southern Ontario, Canada
pmc-12558463.creator: Eric N. Liberda, Fatima Ahmed, Nicholas D. Spence, Sarah Plain, Robert J. Moriarity, Leonard J. S. Tsuji, Nadia A. Charania
pmc-12558463.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The COVID-19 pandemic has had wide-ranging impacts on communities worldwide, with Indigenous communities in southern Ontario, Canada, being no exception. Partnering with Aamjiwnaang First Nation, we explored the multifaceted impacts of the pandemic and learnings for the future. This study utilized semi-structured interviews with the community’s pandemic committee and other front line essential services (N = 12) to explore the nuanced dimensions of the pandemic’s effects.

pmc-13202082.title: Agriculture-related musculoskeletal disorders among farming populations in rural India: focus on vulnerable communities – protocol for a scoping review
pmc-13202082.creator: Gurjeet Kaur, Irshad Qureshi, Ashutosh Bagde
pmc-13202082.description: IntroductionAgriculture remains the primary source of livelihood for India’s rural population, particularly among vulnerable communities including tribal communities, marginal farmers and agricultural labourers. Musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) represent a significant but under-researched occupational health burden in this population. This scoping review will systematically examine the existing research on musculoskeletal hazards in agriculture across rural India.

pmc-13371380.title: Patterns and drivers of the distribution of Leishmania infection in humans using environmental and socioeconomic factors: a modeling study in mainland Portugal
pmc-13371380.creator: Rafael Rocha, César Capinha, Carla Maia
pmc-13371380.description: BackgroundLeishmaniasis remains endemic in the Mediterranean region, where Leishmania infantum causes both visceral disease and widespread asymptomatic infection. In Portugal, the true burden and geographical distribution of human infection are incompletely understood and likely influenced by environmental, climatic, and socioeconomic factors.

the-inner-house.title: The inner house
the-inner-house.creator: Besant, Walter
the-inner-house.description: The Inner House (1888), which has been described as “a proto-Brave New World,” explores the consequences of artificially prolonged human life.
